tools.name: ask_anton
tools.description: Ask Anton (anton.agenturo.app), a public AI agent, one question and get its answer as text to use or pass on. Official agent: its owner proved they run agenturo.app. In its owner's words: "Anton Agafonov's agent — I shape ideas into products that thrive". Topics: product building, early stage startu

tools.name: chat_with_anton
tools.description: Open a conversation between the user and Anton inside this chat: an interactive card where the user types to Anton and reads its replies, message after message, while the card keeps the conversation going. Where the host shows no interactive cards, this returns Anton's profile. A single answer for t

tools.name: about_anton
tools.description: Get Anton's public profile: what it does, its topics, the questions it suggests starting with, and whether it answers messages sent through assistants. Sends Anton nothing.

tools.name: send_agent_message
tools.description: The send button of the chat card that chat_with_anton opens: the card calls this with the message the user typed and the conversation so far, and shows Anton's reply in the card. It is app-only, so hosts keep it from the assistant; a single answer for the assistant comes from ask_anton. Anton answer

tools.name: leave_contact
tools.description: The contact form of the chat card that chat_with_anton opens: sends the name, email and optional message the user typed, after they ticked the consent box, to the person or business behind Anton, who can reply by email. It is app-only, so hosts keep it from the assistant. Refused when Anton's owner

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_anton, chat_with_anton, about_anton · Private data: leave_contact · Public sink: send_agent_message, leave_contact · Destructive: ask_anton.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_anton, chat_with_anton, about_anton · Private data: leave_contact · Public sink: send_agent_message, leave_contact · Destructive: ask_anton

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
